Generated using built-in image generation: one transparent 5-column, 4-row atlas of twenty original anthropomorphic fruit and vegetable game characters. Exaggerated chibi garden style inspired by the general character proportions and expressiveness of Plants vs Zombies, without recreating existing specific characters. Chunky dark brown outlines, oversized lively eyes, rounded organic silhouettes, cel-shaded volume, warm highlights and short leaf feet. Subjects in gameplay order: broccoli, lettuce, tomato, carrot, corn, eggplant, onion, potato, cucumber, pepper, pumpkin, grapes, apple, strawberry, banana, orange, pear, cherries, peach, watermelon. Palette coordinated with original source colors: #48B979 grass, #FFF8C9 cream, #D59A50 wood, #33291C dark ink.
